app.description: A curated, source-linked atlas of major Indonesian infrastructure and PSN programmes: roads, railways, airports, seaports, factories, energy, water, urban and coastal projects that are operating, under construction, planned or stalled.
app.title: Indonesia Infrastructure Atlas
companies.lede: Organisations linked to atlas projects through a sourced role. A profile without a link is a reference record, not a claim of activity.
companies.no_roles: No project role is linked yet. The profile is a reference record.
companies.title: Companies and agencies
corridor.intro: Five defined corridors. Network progress is shown where a published kilometre breakdown exists; where it does not, the route total is published without a guessed percentage. Segment coverage and unallocated length stay visible.
corridor.no_events: No dated event is recorded for this corridor yet. Openings are tracked at project level where an exact date is available.
corridor.no_segment_note: No segment table. The route total is published, but no operational-km series exists, so no percentage is estimated.
corridor.no_segments: No section list has been published for this corridor. The route total is the only verified figure; no progress share is inferred.
corridor.partial_note: The section table is partial: the unlisted length stays in the corridor total rather than being assigned to a section.
corridor.reconcile_note: The section lengths reconcile to the published corridor total.
corridors.no_match_body: Clear the search to see all five corridors.

data.claims_note: Every project has a status claim and a claim for each populated numeric fact.
data.conflict_note: Both values and both sources stay visible. A resolution says what the atlas publishes; it does not erase the disagreement.
data.dictionary_note: {fields} fields across {tables} tables. The same table is downloadable as CSV.
data.freshness_note: Rows are reported fresh for 183 days after last_verified, due soon in the final 30 days, and stale after six months. As of {as_of}, the next record falls due on {next_due}.
data.gap_claims: Claims: {claimed} of {total} projects have a claim for the status and every populated numeric fact ({claims} atomic claims). Register-only rows claim the PSN listing, location and active designation, not implementation.
data.gap_companies: Companies: {companiesTotal} organisations are curated, {companiesLinked} have at least one project role and {companyLinks} role links are recorded. The V4 target is 300 profiles; {companyGap} remain.
data.gap_conflicts: Conflicts: {total} recorded, {open} still open. Both values and sources stay in the register rather than only in a free-text note.
data.gap_corridors: Trans Sulawesi and Trans Kalimantan publish a route total only: no current operational-km series or segment table was found. Trans Sumatra and Trans Papua segment tables are partial and say so.
data.gap_estate_coords: Estate coordinates: {official} SEZ/shared zones use official KEK points, {osm} industrial areas use OSM/Nominatim place points, {regency} still use regency centroids, {manual} uses a power-station point and {unknown} register-only PSN areas use province centroids with no boundary.
data.gap_estates: Estate coverage: {industrial} industrial-estate designations and {sez} SEZs ({total} rows, {both} shared) against a 2026 benchmark of 179 industrial estates. The 179 target is met; {unknown} PSN industrial areas are register-only, with no area or boundary yet. The {gap_rows}-row 2024 audit ledger is in Downloads: {resolved} resolved, {open} named additions still open and {not_required} count placeholders no longer needed.
data.gap_freshness: Freshness: {records} project and estate rows are checked; the next record falls due on {next_due}. No stale rows in this build.
data.gap_industry: Industry, energy and water: {factory} factory rows, {energy} energy projects and {water} water, irrigation and supply rows. Plant and project points are approximate; capacity and investment are only as good as the cited company or press source. Transport points are also approximate, and the PSN review gives no rail length or asset capacity.
data.gap_programmes: Programmes: {total} of 24 active PSN programmes recorded; {lead} have a lead agency, {links} have a linked project and {target} have a published target. The annex states no budgets or indicators, so those gaps are explicit.
data.gap_projects: {total} projects: {investment} with an investment figure, {progress} with reported progress and {length} with a route length. {unverified} are register-only PSN rows with no implementation facts yet.
data.gap_psn: {unknown_psn} of {roads} road rows have unknown PSN status; {approximate} of {total} rows use approximate coordinates; {province} use province centroids and are not plotted.
data.gap_transport: Transport PSN: {current} of {target} represented (13 rail, 7 airports, 15 seaports). The Nusantara airport is an additional national gateway, not a PSN row. Status is as of 19 February 2026, the date of the Kemenhub review.
data.gap_verification: Verification: {official} official, {single} single-source, {dual} dual-source and {unverified} register-only.
data.inclusion_body: Roads: major toll corridors and PSN national roads. Airports and seaports: PSN or KPBU designated. Factories: PSN manufacturing plants, Hilirisasi Stage II plants and private plants with investment of at least Rp 1 trillion; estates and pure mining pits are excluded. Energy: PSN refineries and LNG, plus the 100 GWp solar programme. Water: PSN dams, irrigation and water-supply systems. Urban and coastal: IKN Phase 2 and the Giant Java Sea Wall. Housing, technology, education, tourism and agriculture: active PSN entries in those sectors. Programmes: all 24 active PSN programmes in Permenko 16/2025. Estates: the Kemenperin industrial-estate list, official SEZ profiles and register-only PSN industrial areas, one row per zone.
data.inclusion_body2: The Bali, Malacca and Sunda strait bridges are excluded by scope. Estates remain table-only until their coordinates are verified. Register-only PSN rows carry the name, number, sector, location and active status from the annex; they do not claim an implementation status, cost or boundary.
data.indicator_lede: {indicators} indicators, {values} dated values and {phases} phases across {projects} projects. A target is shown only where a source states it; the rest stay visible as gaps.
data.investments_note: Investment figures also carry their own source in investments.csv.
data.lede: What this atlas covers, how a status is decided, where the numbers come from, and what is still missing. Counts are generated from the curated tables at build time.
data.no_claim_gaps: No claim gaps were found in this build.
data.no_stale: No row is stale or due soon in this build. The monthly runbook in the repository lists the refresh order.
data.programme_lede: All {total} active PSN programmes have a record with an official number, bilingual name and summary, and a source. {lead} have a lead agency, {links} have at least one structural project link, and {target} have a published target. Missing targets, budgets and indicators stay visible rather than being inferred.

data.verification_rule: Verification rule. Every row needs a source and a verification date. A status change needs an official source or two independent sources. Each populated numeric fact has an atomic claim, and disagreements stay visible in the notes and the conflict register.
data.what_body: A curated, source-linked map of major Indonesian infrastructure. It is not a live tracker, an official government dataset, or a complete list.
drawer.no_source: No source is attached to this row yet.
drawer.province_centroid: Province centroid; not plotted on the map
drawer.register_only: Register-only: official PSN name, number, sector and location are sourced; implementation status, cost, capacity and geometry are not yet sourced.
drawer.translated_note: This note is quoted in its source language.
estates.note: Coordinates: 25 SEZs use official KEK points, 27 industrial areas use OSM/Nominatim place points, 133 use regency centroids, one uses a power-station point and 18 register-only PSN areas use province centroids with no estate boundary. The 179 industrial-estate target is met. The 2024 audit ledger has {resolved} resolved, {open} named additions still open and {not_required} count placeholders no longer needed. Sources: Kemenperin estate directory, KEK profiles, PSN register and industrial-area sources, and OpenStreetMap (ODbL).

estates.records: {total} records: {sez} SEZs and {industrial} industrial-estate designations, including {both} zones shared with SEZs. This is a table view; the map layer waits for verified coordinates.
